name: magnified-doc
blurb: Tooltip component with backdrop blur styling, often paired with magnifying dock effects.
description: Radix-based tooltip with custom backdrop blur and dark/light theme styling. Exports TooltipProvider, Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, and TooltipContent as a compound component system.
use_when: Styled tooltips that need glassmorphism effects or enhanced visual polish.
avoid_when: Performance-critical contexts where backdrop blur would harm frame rate.
a11y: Trigger is keyboard-focusable; tooltip appears on hover only.
